description: Na₈MgTi₂O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Mg-O bond lengths are 2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.80 Å) and two longer (1.90 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.86 Å) and two longer (1.87 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Ti atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃Ti trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Ti atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃Ti tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom.
